title: BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionDeny
description: The server judged the invocation high-risk, or reached no judgement and did not hold it for client approval (for example, because the organization is out of credits or has reached a spend limit); it does not execute and a synthetic error tool result is appended.

reason_code.description: The judgement's grounds in registry-bound terms. Open registry; currently "high_risk" (judged high-risk; the call does not run) and "indeterminate" (no judgement was reached; the call does not run). Clients must tolerate values outside this set.
